acs.text_first_line: Scenario: AC1 The pick is the partner the scorecard ranks first on measured return (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC2 Not recorded (legacy RWB-E6-031 AC2)
Scenario: AC3 The pick is recorded with its rule and scorecard versions before the instruction exists (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC4 No eligible partner, or no open capacity, holds the placement (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC5 A stale score product stops the placement (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC6 One placement carries one instruction, one event and one clock (new, D-RCV-60)
Scenario: AC7 The panel is this service's and the ACE data is not (new, D-RCV-60)

ops_consumed: GET the case read, rwb-case (P3), /api/recovery/case/v1, operation name placeholder
GET DP08 Partner performance, DP11 Scores and route economics and the freshness read, rwb-source-data (P1), /api/recovery/source-data/v1, operation names placeholder
GET the scorecard rule in force, rwb-decision (P7), /api/recovery/decision/v1, operation name placeholder
GET the session and the right of the caller, rwb-access (P4), /api/recovery/access/v1, operation name placeholder
events_published: rwb.partner.InstructionIssued.v1 on rwb.partner.events.v1, keyed by the case reference, one per placement through the outbox; its legacy identifier is EV-20 or EV-21 and the mapping is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-3110; ASM-5363)
workflows: InstructionWorkflow on queue rwb-partner in namespace rwb-recovery, one execution per instruction, holding the partner clock of the instruction type
issueInstruction activity on queue rwb-partner, the placement step
